title: Chapter 459: Surrounded By Ghosts
content:
Chapter 459: Surrounded By Ghosts

Wang Shuo didn't have time to think about it, and released the Demon King and the Ice Phoenix King all at once.

At this time, Da Huang also conveyed to Wang Shuo the idea of coming out.

Wang Shuo was a little hesitant. Da Huang's level was still too low. He might be killed in seconds if he came out.

But even so, Da Huang still wanted to come out.

Wang Shuo released Da Huang and told it to hide far away.

At this time, a ghost was approaching.

But after sensing the breath of the Demon King, a black tombstone suddenly exploded.

A black robe with a paralyzed face flew out.

Wang Shuo felt the breath of the other party, and it was also a king-level ghost.

Wang Shuo secretly said that it was not good, it seemed that he had really walked into a ghost's nest.

"Since you have come to the territory of our Blood River Gang, it is your honor to be my little brother."

Wang Shuo looked at the nearly ten ghosts around him and had an ominous premonition in his heart.

The battle was about to break out.

Wang Shuo waved his spear and kept resisting the attacks of the ghosts.

These ghosts have high IQs and can use the weapons in front of them, making them very difficult to deal with.

Wang Shuo was immediately in danger, but fortunately Wang Shuo had the red pupil state, and the more he fought, the greater his advantage became.

As long as the battle dragged on to the later stage, Wang Shuo would not be afraid at all.

"Woof, woof."

Wang Shuo heard Da Huang's cry and felt that Da Huang should want Wang Shuo to kill a ghost.

But in the current situation, it was good enough to be able to defend.

After a while, Wang Shuo and Bing Fenghuang cooperated to freeze a ghost, and Wang Shuo took the opportunity to use Shura Slash.

Finally killed one.

The ghost turned into death and was about to escape back to the grave.

But Da Huang sucked it in.

Wang Shuo was shocked. Could it be that Da Huang was possessed?

This is really fucking true. If you don't commit suicide, you won't die!

I told you not to come out, but you insisted on coming out.

But after a few breaths, Da Huang did not have any other changes, but instead exhaled the death air again.

Wang Shuo observed Da Huang's situation while fighting.

I thought: "Silly dog, you are here to show off smoking! Can you just breathe in the dead air?"

Wang Shuo was a little confused. Looking at Da Huang's appearance, his strength has obviously improved, but it is certain that it is not because of this dead air.

Otherwise, why didn't Da Huang breathe in the ancient battlefield and when fighting with the Black Dragon King?

It should be that the dead air here contains the energy it needs for evolution.

Wang Shuo couldn't figure it out, so he simply stopped thinking about it.

Fight against the ghosts around him with all his strength.

The current situation is not optimistic.

The Demon King was dragged by the king-level ghosts, and it is still unclear who will win in a short time.

Wang Shuo and Bing Fenghuang were surrounded by more than a dozen high-level ghosts of the Blood River Gang, but they were full of murderous intent.

Just now, Wang Shuo and Bing Fenghuang suddenly attacked and caught them off guard, so they were lucky to solve one.

But now the ghosts are on guard, and it is obvious that they can't repeat the same trick.

Wang Shuo had to fight and retreat, hoping to stay away from their tombstones.

I don't know if these ghosts dare to chase them away from the tombstone.

Wang Shuo guessed that they should not dare, because Liu Han had roughly revealed that other ghosts could occupy the tombstone. This tombstone is like their home and is very important.

Finally, at a weak link of the ghost, Wang Shuo seized the opportunity, used the control skill, and then used a big move to hit it, and took the opportunity to rush out.

After Wang Shuo was safe, he quickly used the summoning method to collect the Demon King and the Ice Phoenix King into the space.

After joining Da Huang, he fled.
